summary: Frontend-only testing of /track public page focused on new features: Share button (WhatsApp), auto-load via ?order= query param, vehicle-type dynamic marker, URL sync on search, currency toggle, i18n (Español/English/Français/Arabic+RTL), and error state. ALL flows passed. Map shows ApiTargetBlockedMapError (Google Cloud API restriction) — reported but NOT counted as bug per main agent note; vehicle marker SVG generator code reviewed and looks correct but cannot be visually validated until Maps JS API is enabled.

issues: Google Maps shows 'Oops! Something went wrong.' due to ApiTargetBlockedMapError. Maps JavaScript API / Directions API need to be enabled in Google Cloud Console for the configured key. Not a code bug.

test_results.search_ORD-4821: PASS — tracking-order-id=ORD-4821, status='In transit', cost='850,00 د.م.' (MAD), share-btn visible
test_results.auto_load_query_param_ORD-4822: PASS — auto-loaded id=ORD-4822, status='Assigned', input prefilled
test_results.currency_toggle: PASS — MAD '850,00 د.م.' ↔ EUR '78,20 €' for ORD-4821; ORD-4823 EUR '16,56 €' (consistent with 0.092 rate)
test_results.language_switch_FR: PASS — share btn shows 'Partager le suivi'
test_results.language_switch_AR_rtl: PASS — dir='rtl' on root, share btn shows 'مشاركة التتبع'
test_results.non_existent_order_error: PASS — ORD-9999 shows tracking-error: 'Order not found'
test_results.vehicle_marker_dynamic_icon: NOT VISUALLY VERIFIABLE — map blocked by ApiTargetBlockedMapError. Code review: vehicleMarkerUrl(type) generates distinct SVGs for truck/car/motorcycle and is correctly passed to <Marker icon={url: vehicleMarkerUrl(order.vehicle_type)...}>. Implementation looks correct.

action_items: Inform user/customer to enable 'Maps JavaScript API' and 'Directions API' in Google Cloud Console for the REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (ApiTargetBlockedMapError). Not a code fix.

Optional: address Google deprecation warning — google.maps.DirectionsService is deprecated since Feb 25, 2026, recommended migration to google.maps.routes.Route.computeRoutes (12+ months notice; no rush).
critical_code_review_comments: PublicTracking.js (368 lines): clean, single responsibility, all interactive elements have data-testid. Good.
lookupOrder uses tr('notFound') inside a sync setError — works because t() is sync; OK.
Share button uses window.open(wa.me) which is correctly newtab; URL is built from window.location.origin + /track?order=ID — verified.
useEffect on mount uses eslint-disable for missing deps (lookupOrder/searchParams) — acceptable for mount-only behaviour.
vehicleMarkerUrl falls back to 'truck' for unknown types — safe default.
EXCHANGE_RATE_MAD_EUR hardcoded constant (0.092) — fine for demo; consider API in production (already noted in comment).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 frontend flows verified; marker icon code-review only due to map block)

seed_data_creation: None — DEMO_ORDERS hardcoded (ORD-4821 truck, ORD-4822 car, ORD-4823 motorcycle).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All /track features (search, ?order= auto-load, URL sync, share via wa.me, currency MAD/EUR, i18n 7 langs with RTL for Arabic, error state) verified. Only blocker is Google Maps API restriction (ApiTargetBlockedMapError) — outside code scope. Vehicle marker dynamic icon could not be visually validated until Maps loads; code is correct.
rca of the issue: ApiTargetBlockedMapError originates from Google Cloud Console settings on the API key (Maps JavaScript API and Directions API not enabled / restricted by HTTP referrer). Mitigation: enable both APIs and whitelist preview.emergentagent.com referrer.
